allOf.$comment: v1p4-2026-09-08, additive relaxation WIDENING qfix2-2026-08-26: `call` is OPTIONAL when EITHER the request carries a non-empty `message` OR the finding is a kind that is call-less by nature (`definition_change`, evidenced by two published tools/list snapshots, `source_call_id: null` by construction). It is REQUIRED otherwise. The qfix2 arm is kept verbatim as the second disjunct so that every payload valid before this change is still valid — a snapshot-only definition_change with an EMPTY message was legal and stays legal. What the first disjunct adds is the case qfix2 left open: every OTHER kind used to be refused with 400 finding_has_no_call even when the operator had written out what they were asking, which is a Flag control that answers 400. The rule that survives is the honest one — a thread must carry something: evidence, or words. `finding` is optional outright (dropped from `required`), which is what makes a message-only thread from an EDGE possible: an edge is a registrable domain, not a drift, so no finding exists to attach. Such a thread is created with evidence_count 0.

provider_host.description: OPTIONAL, additive (v1p4-2026-09-08): the observed host of the edge this thread is about, for a thread that carries NO call. The domain is the anchor and the name is decoration (v1 spec §5), so a message-only thread started from an edge row sends the host it was started from and the thread page resolves a VERIFIED directory name or the bare domain for its provider slot instead of an unattributed consumer-asserted name. IGNORED whenever `call` is present — the evidence's own URL always wins over a client assertion. Unparseable values are dropped, never guessed at.

invitee_email.description: DEPRECATED (v0.1a): optional and ignored — the CP sends no invite email; the consumer copies the thread link.

evidence_origin.description: OPTIONAL, additive (slice2-2026-08-28): how the evidence call was chosen. Absent means "finding" — the flag came off a finding row, so the promoted call's bodies start WITHHELD from the provider. "call_pick" — the operator chose the call while looking at it, so it starts revealed. The CP reads unknown values as "finding" (tolerant).

call.description: The redacted evidence call. OPTIONAL when the request carries a non-empty `message` (any kind, and for a message-only thread with no finding at all) or when the finding is call-less by nature (`definition_change` — qfix2-2026-08-26); REQUIRED otherwise, because a thread with neither evidence nor words says nothing.

finding.description: The finding artifact. OPTIONAL since v1p4-2026-09-08: a message-only thread started from an edge row has no finding — the edge is a domain, not a drift. Absent finding AND absent call is the 0-evidence (question) thread.
